title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE ACT ON PROMOTION OF E-SPORTS (ELECTRONIC SPORTS)
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE ACT ON PROMOTION OF E-SPORTS (ELECTRONIC SPORTS)

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated under the Act on Promotion of E-Sports (Electronic Sports) and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 1-2 (Application Procedures for Designation of E-Sports Facilities)
(1) An operator of a business providing Internet computer game facilities under Article 2, subparagraph 7 of the Game Industry Promotion Act who intends to obtain designation as an e-sports facility pursuant to Article 8 (4) of the Act on Promotion of E-Sports (Electronic Sports) (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and Article 4-2 (1) of its Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall submit to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism an application for designation of an e-sports facility using attached Form No. 1, together with:
1. A statement on computers and peripherals such as keyboards and mice held;
2. A statement on equipment held for viewing and broadcasting e-sports;
3. Records of e-sports competitions hosted during the preceding three years.
(2) "Computers and peripherals having performance prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism" in Article 4-2 (1) 1 of the Decree means computers equipped with hardware and software meeting or exceeding the performance recommended by the developers of games selected as e-sports events under Article 12 of the Act.
(3) "Places meeting the standards prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism" in Article 4-2 (1) 4 of the Decree means places readily accessible from bus stops, subway stations, or similar locations.
(4) A certificate of designation of an e-sports facility under Article 4-2 (2) of the Decree shall be issued using attached Form No. 1-2.

Article 2 (Applications for Designation of Institutions Training E-Sports Specialists)
(1) An application for designation as an institution training e-sports specialists under Article 6 (2) of the Decree shall use attached Form No. 1-3. <Amended Aug. 27, 2019>
(2) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism designates an institution for training e-sports specialists under Article 10 (2) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation using attached Form No. 2 and publicly announce the designation on the Ministry's website. <Amended Aug. 27, 2019>

Article 3 (Promotion and Support of E-Sports Competitions)
The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism may promote and support any of the following e-sports competitions pursuant to Article 11 of the Act: <Amended Aug. 27, 2019; June 9, 2021>
1. Competitions hosted or sponsored by another central administrative agency or local government;
2. Non-profit competitions hosted by organizations related to sports for all or e-sports;
3. Competitions hosted by the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee under Article 33 of the National Sports Promotion Act or the Korea Paralympic Committee under Article 34 of that Act.

Article 4 (Designation of Institutions Selecting E-Sports Events)
(1) The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism may designate an institution meeting all the following requirements as an institution selecting e-sports events (hereinafter referred to as an "event selection institution") under Article 12 (1) of the Act:
1. It shall be a non-profit corporation established under Article 32 of the Civil Act primarily for promoting e-sports or the game industry;
2. It shall employ full-time research personnel capable of professionally performing the selection of e-sports events;
3. It shall possess facilities and equipment for trial testing games subject to event selection;
4. It shall have financial capacity sufficient for its operation.
(2) A person seeking designation under Article 12 (1) of the Act shall submit an application using attached Form No. 3 to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism with the following documents. The Minister shall verify the corporation's registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act:
1. Articles of incorporation;
2. Business plan;
3. Evidence that the requirements under paragraph (1), subparagraphs 2 through 4 are satisfied.
(3) When the Minister designates an event selection institution under paragraph (1), the Minister shall issue the certificate of designation using attached Form No. 4 and publish the designation on the Ministry's website.

Article 5 (Criteria and Procedures for Selecting Events)
(1) An event selection institution shall comprehensively consider the following matters concerning a game when selecting e-sports events:
1. Number and sex of users of the game;
2. Opinions of game users concerning the selection of the game as an e-sports event;
3. The rating classification of the game under Article 21 of the Game Industry Promotion Act;
4. Fairness of competition rules relating to the game.
(2) A person seeking selection of a game as an e-sports event shall apply to the event selection institution and submit materials concerning each matter listed in paragraph (1). <Amended Aug. 27, 2019>
(3) In addition to paragraphs (1) and (2), detailed criteria and procedures necessary for selecting events shall be determined by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism in consultation with the event selection institution.

Article 6 (Submission and Public Announcement of Event Selection Results)
(1) When an event selection institution selects an event pursuant to Article 5 (1), it shall report the selection without delay to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
(2) The Minister shall notify the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayors, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Provincial Governors, and Special Self-Governing Province Governor of the selection results submitted under paragraph (1), and publish the results on the Ministry's website. <Amended Aug. 27, 2019>

Article 7 (Institutions Eligible for Designation as E-Sports Industry Support Centers)
"Institutions prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism" in Article 13 (1) 3 of the Act means any of the following: <Amended Nov. 19, 2019>
1. Non-profit corporations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act for the purpose of promoting e-sports;
2. The Korea Creative Content Agency under Article 31 of the Framework Act on the Promotion of Cultural Industries;
3. Other institutions established to develop the e-sports industry and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism as capable of performing the functions of an e-sports industry support center.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 129, Aug. 24, 2012>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rule of the National Sports Promotion Act) <Ordinance No. 441, June 9, 2021>
Article 1 (Effective Date) These Rules shall enter into force on June 9, 2021.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) The Enforcement Rule of the Act on Promotion of E-Sports (Electronic Sports) is partially amended as follows:
In Article 3, subparagraph 3, "Integrated Sports Council" is replaced with "Korean Sport & Olympic Committee".
(2) Omitted.
